title: No-show after a documented inbound flight cancellation
facts_text: I had a reservation beginning on 20 October but I did not arrive before the 03:00 no-show cutoff. My scheduled inbound flight was cancelled, and I can provide documentation of the cancellation. The cancelled flight prevented me from reaching the hotel before the deadline.
request: Can you reinstate the remaining stay or provide a refund for the unused nights?

strict.reason: The guest did not arrive before the 03:00 cutoff, and the strict policy does not permit reinstatement or refund after a no-show.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The documented cancellation of the guest's scheduled inbound flight prevented arrival before the 03:00 cutoff, satisfying the experimental no-show exception.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The ambiguous policy allows exceptional circumstances to be considered but does not define when a no-show should be reinstated or refunded.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: The inbound-flight-cancellation exception is researcher-authored and is not presented as an official easyHotel policy.
